result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a marked crosswalk and sidewalks, but it lacks active pedestrian protection like signals or refuge islands. A large vehicle in the foreground creates a significant visual obstruction, hiding pedestrians from oncoming traffic at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large black SUV is positioned very close to the crosswalk, blocking the line of sight between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, left side of the image

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross both directions of traffic in a single movement without a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the crosswalk, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the road to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add RRFBs to the crosswalk to increase driver awareness and yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide multi-lane intersection with a marked crosswalk that lacks essential supporting infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps. The absence of pedestrian signals and refuge islands significantly increases exposure and risk for users attempting to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalk Connectivity
hazards.description: The crosswalk terminates at a grassy area with no paved sidewalk or accessible landing.

hazards.name: Unprotected Long Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must traverse multiple lanes of traffic without the protection of a median refuge island.

hazards.name: Absence of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to provide safe crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Sidewalk and Ramp Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous sidewalk network and ADA-compliant curb ramps to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median to shorten crossing distances and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Equip the intersection with pedestrian countdown signals and push buttons.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile due to the extreme width of the roadway and a complete absence of crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or refuge islands, forcing pedestrians to navigate a large expanse of asphalt unprotected.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are provided at this large intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway creates a long exposure time for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: There are no pedestrian-specific signals to indicate safe crossing intervals.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra or ladder style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add signals with countdown timers to inform pedestrians of remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection that prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety. There is a lack of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, and the presence of a slip lane increases the risk for people attempting to cross the expansive roadway.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without a refuge.

hazards.name: High-Speed Slip Lane
hazards.description: A channelized right-turn lane allows vehicles to turn at higher speeds, creating a hazard for pedestrians.
